issues.failure_explanation: Both stability theorems list (H0) among their hypotheses, but (H0) is never defined anywhere in the paper: the only hypotheses introduced are (H1)-(H3) for the stationary case and (F1)-(F3) for the time-dependent case. The statements' hypothesis sets are therefore incomplete and the theorems cannot be checked as stated.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Delete the references to (H0) in both stability theorems (or define (H0)); no inference, estimate, or construction needs to change.
issues.overall_effect: The hypotheses of the steady-state stability theorem (thm: stability) and of the unlabelled time-dependent stability theorem are incomplete; the guarantees cannot be verified against the stated assumptions. The proofs use only (H2)-(H3) and (F1)-(F3), so the estimates themselves survive once the undefined reference is removed.
issues.title: Stability theorems invoke undefined assumption (H0)
issues.why_classification: A one-line local repair (dropping or defining the undefined reference) preserves every substantive claim and guarantee of both stability results.
